additional_info.subject: ID0472473-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2 / S6 313706372004] PowerConverter 7 not found CRM:03276000018
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0472473
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / S6 313706372004
Charger ID / Serial No.:
EP1uND
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
PowerConverter 7 not found
Following our diagnostic procedure for the power converter issue, we have analyzed the screenshots provided and confirmed that
Converter [7]
is currently reporting a fault.
To resolve this, please follow the troubleshooting steps below:
1. CanCommLoss:
Check the
CanCommLoss
(
Black and white cable
) attached to Converter [7]. Ensure they are securely seated and free of damage.
To confirm that you are checking the converters on the "Converter_Group_DC4" I’m sharing this screenshot with you since we don’t have the converter serial number.
2. Component Swapping Test:
If the cables are properly connected, please swap Converter [7] with the adjacent functional unit.
▹
If the fault
follows the converter
to the new position, it confirms the hardware itself is faulty.
▹
If the fault
stays at the same position [7]
, the issue likely lies with the cabling or the communication port.
Conclusion:
If the hardware fault is confirmed after the swap, the converter will need to be replaced.
Power Converter AC/DC:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
